descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# LoveSweet — In VR, reach for the stars and gently reshape the world

Put on your Meta Quest and look up at the night sky…
Those twinkling stars are no longer just distant lights — **they are yours to reach out and pick.**

Every star belongs to a different constellation and carries a unique emotional “Expectation” — bravery, gentleness, curiosity, calm, and more.

You can **fly freely through the dreamy sky**, weightless and boundless, just like soaring in a real dream. Feel the wind brush your fingertips as stars glow in your palm — the immersion will make you say “wow” out loud.

But the real magic happens when you **infuse a star’s Expectation into the NPCs** around you.

A timid NPC gains bravery and ventures into the unknown.

A cold NPC becomes caring and starts looking after others…

Every choice you make quietly changes their behavior, letting the whole world evolve because of you.

**LoveSweet** isn’t just an exploration game — it’s your personal **gentle dream-weaving journey.**

Here, you are both traveler and a little god.

Every star you pick, every flight, every infusion brings brand-new stories and heartfelt moments.

Perfect for anyone seeking healing, creativity, and pure wonder in VR.

# Key Features 
- Exclusive VR immersive star-picking and dream flight experience

- Constellation “Expectation” infusion system that changes NPC behavior and world paths

-  Highly free dream-sky exploration  

- Warm, healing emotional stories and creative joy

Ready to try?
